slides.title: • Problem:

blocks.text:
Sparse IMUs can’t measure absolute position. Errors producing physically impossible artifacts.
(e.g. foot sliding, foot ground penetration, foot floating)
(1) Double integration: IMU gives acceleration. Error grows as 𝑡2.
(2) Foot contact = Velocity 0: the only anchor that stops drift.
(3) Foot dynamics = Body dynamics: GRF is the only external force.

Q1. Why not predict the final pose directly?

blocks.text: Q1. Why not predict the final pose directly?

• KinematicsNet
• Infers motion from sparse sensor observations
• Learns ambiguous human pose from data
• Sensors → Estimated kinematics

• DynamicsNet + Physics Simulator
• Converts the estimated motion into physically
executable motion
• Control action → Physical state transition

PINNs encourage equations through a training loss,
whereas a physics simulator enforces contact-rich dynamics at every timestep.

slides.raw_text:
Q1. Why not predict the final pose directly?
Perception
• KinematicsNet
• Infers motion from sparse sensor observations
• Learns ambiguous human pose from data
• Sensors → Estimated kinematics
Physics
• DynamicsNet + Physics Simulator
• Converts the estimated motion into physically
executable motion
• Control action → Physical state transition
Q2. Why not a PINN?
PINNs encourage equations through a training loss,
whereas a physics simulator enforces contact-rich dynamics at every timestep.
